costs.scope: Observed incremental trial costs with existing Source/teacher caches; not standalone end-to-end inference latency

shared_costs.scope: Once per-query cached-evidence/bank construction and total observed CPU query wall time; not full Source/expert inference latency

bank_statistics.scope: Label-free bank statistics over all fixed physical nodes, excluding observed nodes in unobserved denominators

candidate_coverage.scope: Fixed sampled unobserved nodes with GT, excluding all eight observation positions
candidate_coverage.warning: GT selects a candidate independently at scored unobserved nodes; all other nodes retain E. This is an offline oracle diagnostic, not a method or online selection. Its dense interpolated vIoU is not the exact global maximum over all candidate trajectories.
